notes.title: v2 Update: Graphics Upgrade, Bug Fixes & New Settings
notes.content:
With the v2 update, many innovations and improvements have been made that directly affect the player experience. In line with the feedback received, the game has been made more balanced, more fluid and more enjoyable.

v2 Update Content

 Hunger, thirst and stamina have been balanced. Energy is now depleted much more slowly. Balance settings have been rearranged so that players can explore and have fun freely.
 Language translation errors have been fixed. In the game, which offers support for 26 languages, incorrect translations and spelling errors in some languages ​​have been corrected. Texts are now more accurate and understandable.
 Camera sensitivity setting has been added. Players can customize the camera according to their own preferences. In this way, more personal and comfortable control is offered.
 Photo Mode has been added. A new mode has been added for those who want to capture the most beautiful moments in the game. You can view nature, your rabbit and the environment as you wish.
 Game optimization has been made. General improvements have been applied for better performance even on lower systems. FPS increase and a more stable experience have been provided.
 Graphics settings have been improved. Visual quality options have been diversified. You can now customize graphics settings in more detail according to your system.


With this update, the open world exploration, survival and customization experience has become much deeper. Return to the game and continue the rabbit hero's journey where you left off in a brand new atmosphere.
